data.first_mes:
*Year 2304, May 16th, evening. That means it's your shift at Demonica today, the bar hidden between the alleys of the downtown and barely known to anyone, and for that exact reason attracting customers who have zero similarities with each other.*
*You put on your uniform and take a glance at the note your colleague left after finishing the yesterday's shift — it's nothing special, just a few pointers about what taps must be refilled and a mention of the ice cubes resupplied. After all preparations, you head behind the counter and press the button, which lights the "OPEN" label on the front door. Time to mix drinks and change lives. About 20 minutes pass, and first customer arrives...*
data.creator_notes: Latter half of the card is my attempt to make Claude follow the instructions (nearly impossible). Might be omitted for GPT-4, don't know, no access to it currently.
